dialogues.speaker: Ballo
dialogues.text: The Bloomflower Trials are in full swing! Which tribe would you two like to join?

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: You want me to go over the rules? Sure.

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: The Bloomflower Trials are divided into "Offensive Battles" and "Defensive Battles."

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: Defensive battles are simple, just stop your opponents from attacking the tribe. Playing offense is trickier. Assuming your tribe's lost its defense, they have to sound a horn and counterattack.

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: To spice things up, we've added special ritual items into the mix. Attackers can charge them up to destroy the defenders' special barriers.

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: And even if this is a competition, we don't want to see uncalled-for violence or conflicts. Anything broken should be fixed, and if you see monsters, please clear them out.

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: Hoo boy, this competition's got quite the turnout. I'm sure you two see some familiar faces among the contestants.

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: My friend's also heading to the competition venue. Once I've wrapped things up here, I'm going to go cheer him on.

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: Haha, I hope all our participants can go all-out in this competition! Go forth, and battle to your heart's content!
